newsitem.title: USA: Argentine opposition calls for political openness.
newsitem.headline: Argentine opposition calls for political openness.

text.p: An Argentine opposition leader said Monday that corruption existed at high levels of the country's government, and must be addressed to build public confidence and sustained economic growth.
Senator Graciela Fernandez Meijide of the center-left Frepaso alliance said Argentina needed to build public trust through governance based on increased transparency and concensus building.
"The corruption we have today is a serious thing," Fernandez Meijide told an audience at the Americas Society here. "Corruption reaches to very high levels."
